classification.difficultyReason: Solve a linear first derivative and use a constant positive second derivative to classify one stationary point.

content.prompt: Find and classify the stationary point on $f(x)=(x-3)^2+5$.

spec.description: Upward-opening parabola with its vertex above the x-axis and right of the y-axis. Both axes and both curve ends have arrowheads. No ticks or numerical labels.
spec.mathematics: Equation-driven plot of y=(x-3)^2+5 with independently scaled axes, as an unnumbered qualitative sketch.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied curve and axes only; no stationary-point coordinates or classification.
